title: Total boundedness of compactly supported integral currents (Simon 7.2 proof, (1)–(3))
statement: Assume the Deformation Theorem (DeformationTheorem). Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ U compact, B ∈ [0, ∞), and T_j ∈ D_{m+1}(U) (j ∈ ℕ) integer multiplicity with ∂T_j integer multiplicity, spt T_j ⊆ K and M(T_j) + M(∂T_j) ≤ B for all j (M = M_U). Then for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] and every infinite J ⊆ ℕ there is an infinite J' ⊆ J such that for all i, j ∈ J' there are integer multiplicity R ∈ D_{m+2}(U), S ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with T_i − T_j = ∂R + S and M(R) + M(S) < ε.
lean_statement: DeformationTheorem → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ (B : ℝ≥0∞), B ≠ ∞ → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j).boundary) → (∀ j, (Tj j).support ⊆ K) → (∀ j, (Tj j).mass + (Tj j).boundary.mass ≤ B) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ J : Set ℕ, J.Infinite → ∃ J' ⊆ J, J'.Infinite ∧ ∀ i ∈ J', ∀ j ∈ J', ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1 + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω, Tj i ω - Tj j ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass < ε
